name: app-forest-lime-travel-feature-tiles-map-payments-trips
title: Forest and Lime Travel Feature Tiles
whatItIs: A bento of forest green and lime tiles: a map discovery phone, a trips list with a lime stat strip, a lime tile with a tilted card and confetti for payments, and a wide dark tile with a flight card, home phone and trip checklist, each with a centred caption.
whatItMeans: Alternating dark and lime tiles feel fresh, and confetti around the card celebrates a payment.
techniques: Alternating dark green and lime tiles
Lime stat strip overlapping a list
Confetti pieces around a card as a success moment
Three devices and cards in one wide tile

vocabulary.definition: A tile dedicated to one feature with a caption.
Small coloured pieces scattered around a confirmation.
A row of key numbers in a coloured band.
